{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# This step was already done in previous step, but re-run to ensure
# data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = data[data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Filter for completed orders only (conversion rate is based on completed orders)
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed_data)}')

# Check the channel distribution
print('\nChannel distribution:')
print(completed_data['channel'].value_counts())

# Check the customer_segment distribution by channel
print('\nCustomer segment by channel:')
print(completed_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
